Photo of a woman rlyhelena with blonde hair.

A young woman with blonde hair pulled back loosely sits in the passenger seat of a car, making a playful, tongue-out expression while holding up a peace sign with her right hand. She has a light blue cast on her right arm, and a small triangle  is visible on her ring finger. She wears a blue and white striped button-up shirt unbuttoned over a white ribbed crop top, and her facial expression is cheeky and carefree. The car's interior is visible, including the headrest, seatbelt, and a portion of the rear seat. Through the window, bright, overexposed daylight illuminates the scene, casting strong highlights on her skin and clothing, with soft shadows indicating a high-contrast, midday sun. The background outside the window shows blurred green foliage and a roofline, suggesting a suburban or rural setting. The camera is positioned at a low angle, close to the subject's face, creating an intimate, selfie-style composition that frames her upper body and face as the central focus.
